entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Explicitly set `MaxDepth` when using `Newtonsoft.Json` for SignalR hub protocol #69842
  • Blazor Server: RemoteJSDataStream is orphaned and ends the circuit when sendJSDataStream initiation throws #69838
  • IIS out-of-process hosting truncates `X-Forwarded-For` when the forwarded value exceeds `USHORT` #69831
  • JsonTranscodingRouteAdapter drops literal constraints from single-segment variables #69830
  • A union that `System.Text.Json` cannot classify makes every Minimal API route return 500 (and fails startup with MVC) #69826

Closed

  • [SignalR] Negative SequenceMessage.SequenceId permanently silences a connection #69283
    12.0-preview1
  • SignalR connection tokens are not bound to the endpoint that negotiated them #69090
  • Perf improvement: json, tls-handshakes-httpsys #66565
    11.0-rc2
  • libmsalruntime.so and .NET 10.0.11 #68568
  • Perf regression: antiforgery-generation, antiforgery-validation #66536
    11.0-rc2
